anthropics/skills.prerequisites: Skill-specific Node/Python packages; webapp-testing needs Playwright. Claude-specific tools and optional dependencies are not provisioned.

skills.frontend-design: Intentional UI direction, typography, and subject-specific design guidance.
skills.webapp-testing: Local browser verification with server lifecycle examples.
skills.mcp-builder: Structured MCP tool design, implementation, and evaluation workflow.
skills.skill-creator: Skill authoring with activation and output evaluation resources.
skills.claude-api: Vendor-maintained Claude API and SDK development guidance.
skills.internal-comms: Progress updates, incident reports, and organizational communication examples.
skills.brand-guidelines: Concrete typography and brand reference; Anthropic branding needs adaptation.
skills.theme-factory: Reusable themes and consistent presentation styling.
skills.canvas-design: Poster and visual composition workflow with bundled fonts.
skills.algorithmic-art: Generative art workflow with reusable HTML templates.
skills.slack-gif-creator: Animation utilities and Slack-oriented GIF constraints.
skills.web-artifacts-builder: Interactive artifact creation and bundling instructions.

obra/superpowers.prerequisites: Git and coding/test tools; delegation skills require compatible subagent APIs. Framework-level activation is opt-in.

skills.brainstorming: Clarify requirements and design before implementation.
skills.systematic-debugging: Establish and test a cause before changing code.
skills.test-driven-development: Development workflow based on failing and passing behavior tests.
skills.verification-before-completion: Demand fresh verification evidence before declaring completion.
skills.writing-plans: Break implementation into reviewable tasks and checks.
skills.executing-plans: Carry out a previously reviewed implementation plan.
skills.requesting-code-review: Request focused review with context and verification evidence.
skills.receiving-code-review: Evaluate review feedback before implementing it.
skills.writing-skills: Develop and evaluate reusable agent instructions.
skills.using-superpowers: Opt-in framework activation and general skill-selection behavior.
skills.diagnosing-superpowers: Diagnose framework installation and invocation issues.

K-Dense-AI/scientific-agent-skills.prerequisites: Skill-specific scientific Python packages; some require Python 3.12+. Optional search, figures, and exports may require third-party keys, sibling skills, Pandoc/XeLaTeX. Runtime not tested.

skills.literature-review: Reproducible searching, screening, synthesis, and coverage limitations.
skills.citation-management: Citation metadata checks, DOI workflows, and bibliography scripts.
skills.scientific-critical-thinking: Evidence appraisal, confounding, bias, and inference limits.
skills.peer-review: Structured manuscript appraisal and review preparation.
skills.statistical-analysis: Assumption checks, effect sizes, power, and transparent reporting.
skills.experimental-design: Design selection, randomization, factorial design, and pseudoreplication checks.
skills.exploratory-data-analysis: Format-aware inspection and data quality reporting.
skills.scientific-visualization: Figure meaning, uncertainty, accessibility, export, and verification.
skills.matplotlib: Programmatic plotting reference and export patterns.
skills.statsmodels: Statistical estimation, diagnostics, and model workflows.
skills.markitdown: Convert office files and other documents to Markdown for analysis.
skills.scientific-writing: Evidence-led scientific writing and manuscript structure.
skills.scientific-slides: Research presentation design and slide preparation.
skills.research-grants: Structured research proposal and grant writing.

trailofbits/skills.prerequisites: Git and language tooling; optional analyzers and credentials. Named agent helpers may need upstream plugin installation. CC-BY-SA-4.0 applies to these unchanged bundles.

skills.differential-review: Security review of changes with history, impact scope, and evidence.
skills.property-based-testing: Invariants, oracles, shrinking, and selection of useful properties.
skills.sharp-edges: API and configuration designs that enable security mistakes.
skills.audit-context-building: Build system context before vulnerability conclusions.
skills.variant-analysis: Search for related patterns after a confirmed issue.
skills.modern-python: Modern Python project and toolchain conventions.
skills.semgrep: Semgrep static analysis and finding triage.

supabase/agent-skills.prerequisites: Postgres/Supabase project; database CLI or connected Supabase MCP for live actions. Import grants no database access.

skills.supabase-postgres-best-practices: Postgres queries, schema, connections, migrations, security, and indexes.

huggingface/skills.prerequisites: Skill-specific Hugging Face libraries/CLI; HF_TOKEN for gated data/account actions. Model evaluation may need GPU. Remote jobs can incur charges.

skills.huggingface-datasets: Read-only Dataset Viewer pagination, filtering, metadata, and parquet.
skills.huggingface-community-evals: Local evaluation with inspect-ai/lighteval and explicit backend requirements.
skills.huggingface-local-models: Local model setup and quantization guidance.
skills.huggingface-gradio: Gradio components, events, and interaction patterns.
skills.huggingface-papers: Hub paper discovery and management, distinct from systematic review.
skills.hf-cli: Official Hub CLI reference; account writes require task-specific authorization.

openai/plugins.prerequisites: Skill-specific MCP/account connections or platform CLIs. Sentry needs a locally configured read token; Notion needs its connector; Android needs an emulator. Plugin wiring is not bundled.

skills.plugins/openai-developers/skills/build-c: Current Apps SDK scaffolding and docs-first MCP/widget workflow.
skills.plugins/openai-developers/skills/chatgpt: ChatGPT app submission requirements and preparation.
skills.plugins/cloudflare/skills/wrangler: Cloudflare CLI configuration and local development reference.
skills.plugins/cloudflare/skills/agents-sdk: Cloudflare Agents SDK patterns; distinct from OpenAI Agents SDK.
skills.plugins/sentry/skills/sentry: Read-only production issue inspection with a bundled API client.
skills.plugins/notion/skills/notion-research-do: Source-linked synthesis of connected Notion pages.
skills.plugins/notion/skills/notion-knowledge-c: Capture notes and decisions as structured Notion content.
skills.plugins/notion/skills/notion-meeting-int: Meeting preparation from connected workspace context.
skills.plugins/notion/skills/notion-spec-to-imp: Translate workspace requirements into plans and tasks.
skills.plugins/test-android-apps/skills/android: Emulator-based app inspection and QA procedures.
